summary_1line: Bhishma devastates the Pandava forces until Bhima confronts him and slays several of Duryodhana’s brothers, spreading fear and recalling Vidura’s warnings.

image_candidates.scene_text: Bhima stands in his chariot loosing arrows as the severed heads of Duryodhana’s armored brothers fall to the blood-soaked battlefield around him.
Bhishma, blazing like the sun, rains arrows in every direction while shattered chariots, riderless elephants, and fallen warriors cover the field.
Bhima’s arrow slays Bhishma’s charioteer, and the uncontrolled horses drag the great warrior’s chariot wildly across the battlefield.
